name: Mega-NeRF Training Configuration
definition: A training configuration for NeRF that uses hierarchical sampling with a shared MLP for coarse and fine stages, mixed-precision training, and Adam optimizer to accelerate training and reduce model queries.
summary: Mega-NeRF is a NeRF training configuration that accelerates large-scale scene training by using a single shared MLP for coarse and fine sampling, reducing model size and query costs.
